meta.purpose: Tax frictions for billing Gulf (GCC) clients, if the agency expands beyond Egypt. Same net-cash logic as egypt_tax_2026.json — apply before believing a gross quote.
meta.source: Verified research report, June 2026. Confirm with a local advisor before contracting.
meta.strategic_note: Many Egyptian agencies set up a UAE free-zone entity for regional billing specifically because the UAE withholds 0% on outbound service payments — it removes the cross-border WHT trap entirely.

saudi_arabia.implication: Classify the service carefully — 'technical/consulting' (5%) vs 'management' (20%) is a 15-point cash swing. Price the WHT in or gross-up.

uae.withholding_on_nonresident_services: 0% on all cross-border outbound payments (dividends, interest, royalties, service fees remitted in full)
uae.implication: Frictionless for outbound payments — the preferred GCC billing hub for regional work.
